title: I hope Santa’s Sack works better than these bags.
text:
Complete garbage. I ordered 4 of these little gift bags and the bags are a complete waste of time. Here are the issues I have with them.
1. The sticker with the barcode on them gets ripped in order to open the small plastic wrapping they come in. So you have to do some digging to find out which is which if you ordered more than one as I did.
2. It’s very difficult to unfold the bags and it almost tears the paper trying to get them fully open.
3. The small Velcro circle that keeps the “bag” closed clings harder to the other flap of Velcro than it does the adhesive it’s supposed to be anchored with. So when you open the bag you can’t reseal it and you’re left with a sticky circle where half of the Velcro closure should be.
4. As you can see from the photo provided, the “handle” comes off with very little effort. Mine popped off while wrestling with the bag to open up.
5. There is no denomination printed on the gift card itself.
I bought 4 gift bags with different amounts and aside from reviewing my purchase online, I have no way to know which one is which.

I ended up removing the cards and putting them in my own bags to deliver the gift cards.

So for all of the above reasons I would not recommend these gift bags and wish I had stuck with the reindeer or snowflake gift card this year.
Thanks for playing the part of the grinch this year Amazon. Too bad your ubiquitous nature makes consumers of us all.

The first time I tried to purchase something, I caught this, and unchecked it, but then I forgot something so I backed out before finishing, went back and did more shopping, added something else to my cart, and then checked out. This second time checking out, I thought the gift card balance was unchecked, but I honestly didn't pay much attention since I had already gone through those steps (and all I did was add another product to my cart), so this second time I went much more quickly. Only after reviewing the order a day later (when I went to check on something), did I realize that Amazon had again automatically credited the entire gift card balance to the order. Not a huge deal, just a little annoying. Otherwise, everything went great, and I have had no other issues/complaints.
